title: Purchase decision and spare wheel option
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on buyers feeling satisfied with their purchase decision, alongside one complaint about the removal of the proper spare wheel option, while some fragments only mention decision-making context without clear approval or criticism.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say owners are pleased with choosing the car and remain happy with that decision after time with it.

negative.summary: Negative feedback criticizes the decision to drop the proper spare wheel option.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention car buying as a personal decision and attentive staff helping with decision-making, but they do not express a clear view of the car itself.

limitations: This topic mixes purchase-decision satisfaction with a separate product-specific complaint about the spare wheel option.
Several fragments are too brief or contextual to determine a clear sentiment about the vehicle.
